meta.title: Website Maintenance Services in Kochi | Teknoppy
meta.description: Secure, updated, and monitored websites after launch. Kochi team, monthly reporting, off-server backups, and direct support on any platform. Get a quote.

body.text: Teknoppy maintains live websites in Kochi on monthly plans from Rs. 5,000 - covering software and plugin updates tested on staging, uptime and security monitoring, off-server backups, content edits and a written monthly report. We support WordPress, ecommerce and custom-built sites.

Kochi businesses come to us when their site was built years ago and never touched again, when plugins and CMS software have gone out of date, or when nobody has been checking uptime and backups since the developer moved on. Every maintenance plan starts with a free health check of what is currently running on your site before any update goes live.

sections.trustline: 120+ Websites Delivered · In Kochi Since 2018 · Kochi-Based Team, Direct Support Line

sections.h2: What's Included in Every Maintenance Plan

items.title: Software and Plugin Updates on Staging
items.text: We test CMS core, theme, and plugin updates in an isolated staging environment before deploying to your live site, preventing broken layouts and database corruption. Looking specifically for WordPress? See our dedicated WordPress maintenance plans.

items.title: 24/7 Uptime and Security Monitoring
items.text: Uptime is checked every 5 minutes with automated alert pings. Daily malware scans, SSL certificate renewals, and brute-force login protection safeguard your site around the clock.

items.title: Daily Automated Off-Server Backups
items.text: Full-site and database backups are encrypted and stored off-server on AWS S3 with 30-day retention, enabling complete one-click restoration if a server fails.

items.title: Monthly Content Edits & Speed Checks
items.text: Every plan includes dedicated developer hours for banner updates, text changes, and blog publishing, paired with periodic performance tuning to keep Core Web Vitals sharp.

sections.intro: Straightforward monthly retainers with no lock-in contracts. Choose the level of coverage that matches your business:

rows.timeline: Core & plugin updates, weekly off-server backups, 24/7 uptime monitoring, 1 hour content edits, monthly written report. 8-hour response time.

sections.note: Plans are billed monthly with 30 days notice, or annually with a 15% discount. Third-party hosting fees and commercial plugin licenses are separate. Support hours: Mon–Sat, 9:30 AM – 6:30 PM IST with emergency on-call coverage.

items.title: Website Health Audit
items.text: We review your current CMS version, active plugins, server response times, and past vulnerabilities before proposing a plan.

items.title: Maintenance Plan Setup
items.text: We configure off-server automated backups, set up uptime monitoring pings, and establish an isolated staging test environment.

items.title: Scheduled Updates and Monitoring
items.text: Security patches and plugin upgrades are applied on a predictable monthly schedule, with critical zero-day vulnerabilities patched immediately.

items.title: Monthly Written Reporting
items.text: You receive a plain-language summary detailing updates installed, backup confirmations, uptime percentage, and site speed scores.

items.title: Ongoing Support Requests
items.text: Content updates and bug fixes are submitted via email or direct WhatsApp support, resolved within guaranteed SLA windows.

sections.h2: Does Your Website Need a Maintenance Plan?
sections.intro: Without regular upkeep, websites quietly accumulate security vulnerabilities and performance bottlenecks:

items.text: Websites running outdated CMS versions or unpatched plugins that pose severe hacking risks.
Online stores where payment failures, checkout bugs, or broken forms directly cost daily revenue.
Corporate, clinic, and institutional sites where downtime damages trust and brand credibility.
Websites built by freelancers or past agencies with no active technical support arrangement.

items.a: It covers software and plugin updates, uptime and security monitoring, scheduled off-server backups, technical bug fixes, and an allocation of monthly content edits, keeping your live site secure, fast, and up to date.

items.q: How much does website maintenance cost in Kochi?
items.a: Our standard plans range from ₹5,000/month for basic informational websites to ₹10,000/month for growing business sites, and ₹15,000/month for active WooCommerce or Shopify stores.

items.q: How often should a website be updated?
items.a: Maintenance follows three cadences: 1) Security and plugin updates tested and applied monthly; 2) Critical security patches deployed within hours of release; 3) Content, blog, and pricing edits updated as needed within your plan's hours.

items.q: Is there a minimum contract length?
items.a: No long-term lock-in. Our maintenance plans operate on a flexible month-to-month basis with 30 days notice. We also offer annual billing with a 15% discount for teams seeking year-round peace of mind.

items.q: What is not included in a maintenance plan?
items.a: Full website redesigns, extensive custom feature coding, and commercial third-party software/plugin licensing fees are quoted separately. Routine content updates and minor structural tweaks within your monthly hours are fully included.

items.q: Do you maintain websites built by another agency?
items.a: Yes. Most of our maintenance clients come to us with existing sites built by previous developers. We initiate every engagement with a comprehensive security and codebase audit before taking over management.

items.q: What happens if my website goes down?
items.a: Our automated 24/7 monitoring detects outages within 5 minutes. Our engineering team immediately diagnoses the incident, resolves server or database issues, and restores from verified backups if necessary. Critical emergency response is within 2 to 4 hours.

items.q: Is website maintenance different from web hosting?
items.a: Yes. Web hosting is the physical or cloud server where your files live. Website maintenance is the active technical labor of keeping that site updated, secure, optimized, and patched against vulnerabilities. You need both to keep a site healthy.
